approval.decision: Kris replied "Approved" (message 961cbbd1-c3ac-4195-908a-8c320598fc66, design-chat position 978) directly after the final annotated comparison and runnable candidate explicitly identified A2 inspector-v2, source 37d29ca1. The full approved source is 37d29ca180dc81cb350ff8ff99bfaee90e65cea9. Decision context and limitations are retained in APPROVED-HANDOFF.md.
behaviour: Keep the existing Screens Choose / Design / Use in Story flow, production styles/icons and continuous A2 inspector with plain section links.
Add a control to the selected qualified parent; editing keeps its current parent. No reparent field or new API.
Bar binding chooses an existing integer by stable ID; retain canonical decimal bounds and use core validation for exact engine endpoints and positive span.
Bar filled/empty/thumb colors are nullable literal colors; clearing restores native defaults.
Image button uses six typed actual UI-image references with UUID/hash. Normal is required and other states are optional. Display-only fallback thumbnails never write references.
Native fallback is hover -> normal, disabled -> normal, selected -> normal, selectedHover -> hover -> normal, selectedDisabled -> disabled -> normal. selectedHover never falls back to selected.

One displayed width/height pair applies to every explicit image-state asset through bounded native Transform scaling. Aspect linking is opt-in per draft and uses the current Normal image dimensions. Preserve existing layout/order without duplicate xsize/ysize edits.
Reuse the existing context-valid ordered typed action owner, eight-action limit and Finish-last rule.

One combined Apply covers appearance, binding/actions, displayed size and layout. Cancel/no-op add no history. Invalid/stale/missing/type-changed input retains the owning draft and focus; no silent refresh or rebinding.

Keep drafts outside transient DOM with captured source/authoring revisions through navigation, remount and unrelated accepted edits. Restore picker and redraw focus; preserve ordinary numeric and keyboard edits.
Preserve real transactional Undo/Redo, Source and reopen behavior. The fictional prototype does not qualify persistence or runtime behavior.
Six marked inert editor states and sample values never execute game code/actions or persist runtime defaults. Compact editing uses one main scroll and reachable navigation/commit controls.
deviations: The disclosed compact stale-error capture requires scrolling to expose the full commit footer. Production integration must keep commit controls reachable; this is not a waived product gate.
Touched actions restored to original values can retain Unsaved: Actions wording until no-op Apply; no history is added.

The mock uses fictional images, memory-only service callbacks and a schematic canvas. Preserve existing real numeric units/anchors/order, composition, catalog/import and Source owners during integration.

Comparison captures are dark at CSS content widths 1280 or 560, content/PNG height 820 and scale 1; html_preview inner viewport height was 800. Light and other conditions are outside recorded comparison coverage.

Sixteen focused synthetic callback groups and actual html_preview renders do not establish trusted keyboard/Escape, native pointer/file-picker, real core/source/runtime or the full repository design:check. These remain separate required verification.
